posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
@Theponidraws
to explain the posts above: the maker can handle any size of sprites, but in the map editor those sprites need to be cut to a single grid size to allow you to access and see the tiles around them.
otherwise you get problems editing the map around events with larger sprites.
so you'll have to start the game to see how the sprite looks in game if it is larger than 48x48 (which your sprite obviously is)
